run_pose_demo: run the demo script to visualize predicted keypoints on images using mmdet and mmpose
run_pose_demo_with_heatmap: run the demo script with --draw-heatmap to visualize predicted heatmaps alongside keypoints
run_pose_demo_save_predictions: run the demo script with --save-predictions to export keypoint results as JSON files
run_pose_demo_on_directory: run the demo script on a directory of images by passing the folder path as --input
run_pose_demo_on_txt_list: run the demo script on a text file listing image paths as the --input argument
